non_directive_principles.title: Non-Directive Navigation Constraints
non_directive_principles.description: RightER Flow presents options without making recommendations or directing users to specific facilities.

allowed_language: Here are hospitals in your area

display_rules.facility_listing: Display all facilities equally with no visual hierarchy based on recommendation
display_rules.distance_calculation: Show distance as neutral information, not as a suggestion
display_rules.facility_details: Present factual information (address, contact, type) without editorial comments
display_rules.wait_time_display: If available in future, show as estimate with disclaimer, not as decisive factor

backend_constraints.api_responses: Return facilities in neutral order (alphabetical or distance-based) with no 'recommended' flag
backend_constraints.no_filtering_logic: Do not filter out facilities based on assumed user preferences
backend_constraints.equal_representation: All facilities receive equal data completeness and quality

educational_approach.inform: Provide factual education about facility types and when to seek care
educational_approach.empower: Give users information to make their own informed decisions
educational_approach.avoid_directing: Do not tell users where to go or what to do

legal_disclaimers: This tool is for informational purposes only
Not a substitute for medical advice
Consult healthcare professionals for medical decisions
